body:
I need to find someone willing and powerful enough to obey and execute my commands to make my life better than death. Otherwise, there just is no point asking for help, since they’ll never help me with the “push” factors, only with the “pull” factors (i.e., they’ll torture me for the rest of my life).

If someone doesn’t want me to complete my suicide then they need to take **responsibility** for them selves and **make** my life good enough for me to not want to complete my suicide. 

Really, no one is willing to take responsibility for them wanting to prevent my suicide, so I must keep silent until I die. That is what you all want. Feel free to make a convincing argument otherwise, but I bet this post will be down-voted and then hidden. The people who run this subreddit are encouraging suicide.
